text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Inference gateway (private-vpc) high 5xx rate and timeouts across multiple customer routes. Elevated 504/502 on egress path, error spike started ~2026-03-15T10:00Z. Paging oncall. Details: https://pager.example/INC-27765 :rotating_light:

alex: saw the first spike in latency graphs, 5xx coming from inference-gw-egress. Errors correlate with NAT translation failures in the private VPC.

maria: @alex assign me, I'm oncall. Are any customers reporting errors directly?

prod-support: hitting support tickets from two customers (acme-inc, betaapps) reporting timeouts and LLM request failures. Both are on Private deployment in eu-west-1.

kevin: adding context — we rolled a security-group rule change 18m ago for tighter ephemeral port ranges. Could be related.

nisha: copying net logs now. I see repeated TCP RSTs and connection reuse failures where source port appears to be re-used before NAT state fully synced — suspicious translation rotation behavior.

maria: ok, can we confirm whether it's NAT gateway ephemeral exhaustion vs. SG stateful race? quick checks: netstat on gateway, conntrack counts, and sg logs.

kevin: running: ``sudo conntrack -L | wc -l`` -> 184k active entries (expectation ~50k). Ephemeral pool seems exhausted and churn is very high.

kevin: sg logs show a handful of denied packets matching short-lived flows where reply path hits a different NAT translation; looks like asymmetric egress after a translation rotation.

alex: that fits: translation rotation (NAT instance cycling translations to rebalance) + tightened SG ephemeral policy -> replies dropped. Resulting in 5xx/timeouts at app layer.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: A config rollout (sg-ephemeral-restrict) to private-vpc eu-west-1 completed 17m ago across 3 hosts.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) widen ephemeral range on SG to previous values (temporary), 2) disable NAT translation rotation on the gateway pool (if possible), 3) add a targeted route to force sticky SNAT for impacted subnets, 4) notify customers and update status page. We'll do 1 & 3 first as they're quickest.

nisha: Command to widen SG ephemeral ports:
```
# update security group via infra toolkit
infractl sg update --id sg-0a1b2c3d --ephemeral-range 32768-65535
```
Applying to one host now.

kevin: applying sticky SNAT on gateway node rn: ``sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.10.0.0/22 -j SNAT --to-source 35.200.10.45`` (will test on one node).

maria: doing canary change to prod routing for acme-inc subnet to sticky SNAT, monitoring.

prod-support: I sent initial notification to acme-inc and betaapps that we are investigating and implementing mitigations. They asked for ETA. I'll say 30-45m for mitigation progress.

alex: after widening ephemeral range on host-3, I see a drop in conntrack churn from 180k -> 95k and 5xx rate falling ~40% for that AZ.

nisha: good. after adding sticky SNAT on node-7, we saw successful TCP flows for a subset of requests — stateful replies now matching.

maria: continuing: disable translation rotation on NAT pool is next but requires rolling restart of nat-controller — riskier. Keep for later if above mitigations don't fully resolve.

ops-rotation-bot: @maria you have been assigned the on-call handoff for next shift at 11:00Z.

maria: noted. Kevin, please prepare a remediation PR to revert the ephemeral policy change and add a hotfix runbook. I'll start drafting incident timeline and scope.

kevin: PR created: https://git.example/r/infra/sg-hotfix/pull/42 - rollback and temp widen. Also added runbook steps for sticky SNAT.

prod-support: update to customers: we've implemented temporary fixes that are reducing errors. We're monitoring; next update in 30m or if material change.

nisha: metrics look stable for the last 8min in eu-west-1 canary. 5xx down to baseline-ish but still some residual timeouts in one AZ.

maria: action items: (1) keep ephemeral range widened cluster-wide, (2) monitor 30m, (3) schedule a controlled NAT-controller restart during low traffic window to disable rotation if needed, (4) follow-up RCA to include why sg-ephemeral-restrict rollout wasn't flagged by e2e canary.

alex: I'll open a paging ticket for infra-runbooks to cover NAT translation rotation scenarios and request a postmortem with networking and releases.

customer-ops: thanks for the quick work. acme-inc says errors are substantially reduced. pls loop them when we have final RCA.

maria: handoff to next oncall @ops-rotation-bot. If errors recur, escalate to net-eng and schedule NAT-controller restart during maintenance window. Closing paging for now but leaving thread open for updates. :white_check_mark:
